name: Dune Reaper Shriek
tactics: Shrieks follow the same basic attack pattern as drones, with the added advantage of being able to teleport into and out of melee. When a shriek arrives after a shrieking warp, it often chooses to push away all but one enemy that it hits, focusing subsequent attacks on the creature it did not push.

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Forceful Silence
traits.details: When the shriek takes force damage, it cannot use shrieking warp until the end of its next turn.

powers.name: Shrieking Reap
powers.usageDetails: when the shriek uses shrieking warp

effect.description: The shriek uses arm blade twice against the same target. If one attack hits, the shriek teleports the target 2 squares, and the target takes ongoing 10 damage (save ends). If both attacks hit, the shriek teleports the target 5 squares and knocks it prone, and the target takes ongoing 15 damage (save ends).
The shriek is removed from play. At the start of its next turn, it appears in an unoccupied square within 10 squares of its last location and makes the following attack.

hit.description: thunder damage, and the shriek pushes the target 2 squares.
